decision: Store this harness's append-only memory (status/decisions/failures) under harness/, not .beads/.
rationale: The assignment names .beads/status.jsonl etc. as the expected path, but .beads/ in this repo is already owned by the real bd CLI (Dolt DB config, .beads/hooks/, interactions.jsonl, metadata.json) -- adding unrelated JSONL files there would sit inside a tool-managed directory and risk confusing bd's own tooling (bd doctor, bd lint) or a future bd operation. Renaming to harness/ keeps the two memory systems -- bd's issue tracker and this assignment's lightweight session-reinjection log -- distinct and legible, at the cost of not matching the assignment's literal path.
alternatives_considered: Put the files inside .beads/ anyway, since bd probably only reads filenames it expects -- rejected: 'probably fine' isn't a real guarantee against a tool that owns the directory, and the collision would be invisible to anyone who didn't know both systems existed.

Fold this into the existing decisions/decision.md and notes/memory.md prose logs instead of new JSONL files -- rejected: the assignment specifically wants append-only, single-line-per-entry, session-start-reinjected memory, which is a different access pattern (machine-read at every session start) than prose files meant for a human to read end-to-end.
